description: This file is a shell script fragment intended to be included by other shell scripts within a Git project. It provides environment setup, utility functions, error handling, and platform-specific tweaks for managing Git repositories and commands.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message to standard error and exits with status 1.

methods.name: die_with_status
methods.description: Prints an error message to standard error and exits with a specified status code.

methods.name: set_reflog_action
methods.description: Sets the GIT_REFLOG_ACTION environment variable if not already set, used for logging actions in Git reflogs.

methods.name: git_editor
methods.description: Determines and executes the configured Git editor.

methods.name: git_pager
methods.description: Sets up the pager program for Git output, defaulting to 'cat' if output is not a terminal.

methods.name: is_bare_repository
methods.description: Checks if the current directory is a bare Git repository.

methods.name: cdup
methods.description: Changes directory to the top-level of the working tree.

methods.name: require_work_tree_exists
methods.description: Ensures the current directory is within a Git working tree.

methods.name: require_work_tree
methods.description: Ensures the current directory is inside a Git working tree.

methods.name: require_clean_work_tree
methods.description: Checks that there are no unstaged or uncommitted changes in the working directory.

methods.name: pick_ident_script
methods.description: Generates a sed script to extract identity information (author, committer) from a commit.

methods.name: parse_ident_from_commit
methods.description: Creates a sed script to parse identities from commit data.

methods.name: get_author_ident_from_commit
methods.description: Retrieves author identity information from a specific commit.

methods.name: create_virtual_base
methods.description: Generates a virtual base for a three-way merge from two files using git apply.

methods.name: git_dir_init
methods.description: Initializes Git directory environment variables and validates the repository.

methods.name: peel_committish
methods.description: Converts a commit identifier to its full rev-parse form, supporting relative references.
